search.website_text:
Replay Library

English | 日本語

Replay Library records duty replays and files each one by content. A finished recording goes to `replay/replaylibrary`. Play a current-patch replay from an inn. When Replay Converter is loaded, a replay can be converted to the current patch or anonymized. Those buttons stay disabled until Replay Converter is signed in. Opening Replay Converter files loose replays into `replay/replaylibrary`. The first launch copies the whole `replay` folder to `replay-backup-yyyyMMdd-HHmmss` before it moves anything. That copy is kept. ## Install 1. Run `/xlsettings` and open the **Experimental** tab 2. Add this URL under **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exatrines/DalamudPlugins/refs/heads/main/pluginmaster.json ``` 3. Run `/xlplugins` and install **Replay Library** ## Features - **Library** — Browse saved replays, filter them, and play a current-patch replay from an inn - **Recording** — Record checked content types into `replay/replaylibrary` - **Auto-lock** — Keep a set number of replays per duty, with cleared replays first - **Auto-delete** — Move the rest to Deleted after a number of days, then trim that folder by size - **Convert and anonymize** — Shown when Replay Converter is loaded. Disabled until that plugin is signed in - **Language and themes** — English or Japanese, and window themes ## Commands | Command | Description | | --- | --- | | `/lib` | Toggle the library window | | `/lib config` | Toggle settings | ## For developers [MirageUI](https://github.com/exatrines/MirageUI) is included as a submodule. ``` git submodule update --init --recursive dotnet build ReplayLibrary.sln -c Release -p:Platform=x64 ``` Set the dev plugin path to `ReplayLibrary/bin/Release/`, then enable it in the Dalamud installer.
